summary: Scope: the measured feasibility basis for route (b) of the FS-GG/.github#4778 decision (decision comment 6359585393: one fresh GitHub-hosted public-repo ubuntu-24.04 VM per BAR image operation). The decision itself lives in that issue comment, and the consumer is #1032. Evidence pointers: probe result comment https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4778#issuecomment-6363750262, run 39944268141 on image 20261012.334.1 (2026-10-23), artifact bar-capacity-probe.json sha256 f86f4cd13040f08a3c4d935102c256769ef5663f1ce919e7b56256404c273912. Observed on that one VM: a single 150 GiB disk with no separate /mnt; / had 85.79 GiB free at baseline and 125.08 GiB after deleting about 42.6 GB of toolchains in 138 s; a dedicated fallocate+loop+LVM ext4 volume showed 116.64 GiB free, but its preallocation was lost to mkfs discard; MemAvailable was 14.59 GiB after stopping docker/containerd (about 605 MiB margin); nproc and affinity were 4 (zero CPU margin); systemd-run Delegate=yes worked for root and uid 1001; /dev/kvm returned API version 12 after a udev rule; apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1. The host has Buildah 1.33.7 and lacks the controller's Arch library pins; Buildah 1.43.1 and all 13 pins were present only in a digest-pinned Arch userland with archived packages. So #1032's 80 GiB, 14 GiB and 4-CPU floors were met on that VM. This is not a guarantee: GitHub documents 14 GB of disk, and the admission refusals remain authoritative. Proposed by the #1032 owner, not demonstrated by the probe: mkfs -E nodiscard with an allocated-blocks re-read, a daemonless userland in the admitted path, and a userns sysctl change. A rootless build inside the userland was not exercised. The probe is not image evidence and admits no BAR operation.
title: Measured boundary of the hosted-VM BAR resource domain
